power_budget.maix_note: Connector-rated 1A supply budget is not demonstrated recognition-plus-charging demand. Current limit and brownout/startup require measurement.

recognition: MaixCAM2 UART4, J19 exact 6P MX1.25, 1A connector-rated supply budget
streaming: DJI Osmo Action4, J28 power-only Type-C 5V/3A advertisement; no MCU data
stepper: J23 ordinary XH 8P TTL, pins 1/2/7/8 active
stepper_power: PD12 / J14:B30, active high, hardware default off; Q6/Q7 back-to-back PMOS and Q8
model_note: U10 stock SOIC exterior body is generic; exposed pad land pattern follows manufacturer drawing
power_conversion: One TPS56837 8A-class 4.992V buck shared by Core and peripherals; AP2112K 3.3V LDO for TFT/BT; Core AP63203 remains on Core
limitations: Schematic/ERC/resource verification does not certify PCB routing or physical hardware. PCB component sync and native DRC are reported separately.
8A is the buck IC rating, not a demonstrated board output. Thermal, load-step stability, shared-bus noise and short-circuit/inrush behavior require measurement.
Maix MX1.25 contacts are rated 1A; nominal eFuse limit is 0.9986A, with tolerance. Recognition plus battery charging may exceed the available branch power and cause brownout.
Maix six-pin 5V and USB VBUS are common internally: remove J27 before powered USB debug; battery can keep module alive.
Action4 output is fixed 5V, Type-C 3A advertisement, not PD/PPS fast charging. Recording plus charging demand must be tested.
C81 16SVP150M is domestic in-stock but manufacturer NRND; replacement needed for production longevity.
SW2-SW5 unbranded SMD button lead span/contact pairs and TFT mounting-hole pitch still require physical confirmation. Firmware must debounce buttons.
STEP_PWR_EN is PD12/B30, active high and hardware default off; stop motion before cutting power.
